name: Question 3
problem:
Let $f(x)$ be the $6$-periodic extension of the function $F(x)=6{x}^{2}-2$ defined on $[-3,3).$ Select the correct options in the reasoning below, showing the derivation of the Fourier series of the $6$-periodic extension of $G(x)=12x$ from the corresponding Fourier series of $f(x).$The Fourier series of $f(x)$ is given by

$$
6{x}^{2}-2∼16+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{216(-1)^{n}}{{n}^{2}{\pi }^{2}}{{field-1}}.
$$

Question 3

Let f(x) be the 6-periodic extension of the function F(x)=6x2−2 defined on [−3,3). Select the correct options in the reasoning below, showing the derivation of the Fourier series of the 6-periodic extension of G(x)=12x from the corresponding Fourier series of f(x).The Fourier series of f(x) is given by
sin⁡(nπx6)
sin⁡(nπx3)
cos⁡(nπx6)
cos⁡(nπx3)
sin⁡(nπx6)
6x2−2∼16+∑n=1∞216(−1)nn2π2{(sin⁡(nπx3))(S0)}.
